RESPONSE_LAT.formula: 8 (landing seg) + D(krq) + D(krs); one value on every ECTL frame (type parameter)
RESPONSE_LAT.bind_applied: not in param_regen.json (as-built value kept by the bind, or no hook)
RESPONSE_LAT.mismatch: bound RTL RESPONSE_LAT=['80'] on 1/1 qkd_ectl3_kiss_st\w* instances, regen 12

QK_ISSUE_AGE.formula: max(34, RESPONSE_LAT + 11) (static_qk_calendar write-before-read; 34 = attn calendar QK_CONSUME floor, KV owner choice KV-P6 18:09)
QK_ISSUE_AGE.bind_applied: not in param_regen.json (as-built value kept by the bind, or no hook)
QK_ISSUE_AGE.mismatch: bound RTL QK_ISSUE_AGE=['91'] on 1/1 qkd_ectl3_kiss_st\w* instances, regen 34

QK_D_QK.formula: kv_qkh_safe32.calendar_d_qk: D_QK = QK_ISSUE_AGE - 34 (+ data edges); must be >= 0

ahub.__rule__.formula: as-built AP_OFS not in param_regen.json (bind without the KV hook)

VPORT_DQ.formula: max_q(W_q + RT_q) - (W_p + RT_p) (<= 15, else W-lane pads)

CFG_FIA.note: KV-P6-BOOT: the boot generator RL = 4 + WP + O + DQ + RT (adds O) and the PV entry-pad table sets cfg_fia; the compiled boot image (KV_BOOT recipe) is authoritative for cfg_fia / DQ

KVN_A0.formula: KVN_A0_asb + Delta(d2d kvn_word_valid -> seq core) - Delta(d2d att_rx_v -> kvs_attn) (KV-P6 18:09: age a starts at the attention programme request, triggered by att_rx)
KVN_A0.bind_applied: not in param_regen.json (as-built value kept by the bind, or no hook)
KVN_A0.mismatch: bound RTL KVN_A0=['32'] on 1/1 qkd_seq_core_static_s\w* instances, regen 28

D2D_AGES.formula: landed depth d2d_kv/dcal -> kvs_ctl / kvs_attn / seq core, attn tx -> d2d_kv (kv_boot_v36.py DIE_TABLE inputs)

HROOT_DOWN_RET.formula: kvs_ctl.o_hroot_s -> hroot / hroot.o_ctl -> kvs_ctl landed (emb_fill / writer_die)

XDIE_SEAM_K.formula: d2d_link_calendar --die-stages KV half (KV-P6-BOOT KST) = as-built seam + Delta

D2D_TXDP_K.formula: [KS_TXS + KV_CODEC(2) + SK_TXP, 2 + host, 1, 1] + PINREG_EXT (d2d_link_calendar producer_txd); the compute die must bind the same pair image
D2D_TXDP_K.bind_applied: not in param_regen.json (as-built value kept by the bind, or no hook)
D2D_TXDP_K.mismatch: bound RTL TXDP=['50529302'] on 1/1 qkd_d2d_static\w* instances, regen 50529393

D2D_KV_TX_LAT.formula: shared QC<->KV pair image KV TX latency = TXDP K[0] = KS_TXS + KV_CODEC + SK_TXP + PR pin flops, from the KV bound top; BOTH dies bind the same pair image (QC emits it with --peer)
D2D_KV_TX_LAT.note: moved 22 -> 113 vs as-built: re-bind the pair image on both dies
